title: oenothera boothii subsp. rutila
intro: Oenothera boothii subsp. rutila, commonly known as the Fragrant Evening Primrose, is a species of flowering plant in the evening primrose family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera boothii subsp. rutila include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
